items.title: Candoli interviewed by Monk Rowe, 1997
items.q: I got to see it I think it’s at Med Flory’s house, on the mantle.

ctx.x: I know. I ran out of room myself. SuperSax you played with?

Well we’re still working but not as much. You know we did, oh like a dozen recordings at least. And that was a joy. And we did some real great — our first album we won a Grammy for, which was great. And I got to see it I think it’s at Med Flory’s house, on the mantle. © Fillius Jazz Archive -14-
He should loan it out to you guys, and kind of move it around.
